scenes.title: Three Stones North
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Qing, Chen, and Zhou count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Wrapped in Waxed Cloth
scenes.summary: Mei brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Chen lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: The Biscuit Tin
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Qing, Mei, and Zhou untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Brass Compass
scenes.summary: Chen eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Qing discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Four Illustrated Cards
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Song and architect Hao examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and Hao recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Half of a Cake Recipe
scenes.summary: In the café corner, Mei, Song, and Peng read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Five Young Friends
scenes.summary: Zhou, Song, and Hao admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Walk All Four Clues First
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Qing, Chen, and Hao inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along Wutong Lane before breaking the seal.
